purpose: Record the exact causal native-track age gate used to test whether foreground-mass coverage gains can be made less unstable before any predicted-track training.
postrun_note: The two receipts were generated before this config was committed. This file is a postrun reproducibility record, not a preregistration, model-selection protocol, or qualification claim.

mechanism.age_definition: A native track starts at age 1; age increments only when the next observation has the immediately consecutive source-frame index; otherwise age resets to 1.
mechanism.retention_rule: Keep an observation only when the causal age at that observation is at least the configured minimum.
mechanism.candidate: Previously frozen COVTrack-native foreground-mass bbox-head score-contract repair.

fixed_comparison.selection_rule: Existing fixed policy subset and independent first-eight development-prefix subset; no outcome, score, or GT selection.
fixed_comparison.baseline_stream: Existing anonymous COVTrack-native dense physical stream with age 1.
fixed_comparison.candidate_stream: Existing anonymous COVTrack-native foreground-mass physical stream, filtered causally to age 2.

evaluation.geometry_only_gt_index: Existing sealed category-free physical GT index; semantic/category fields are not used.
evaluation.pair_definition: Adjacent observations in each sealed GT track annotation order.

interpretation: This is a category-free causal lifecycle diagnostic. It may identify a useful birth-confirmation mechanism, but it cannot establish OCD/MOT performance, frontend qualification, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
